chunks: As for what was narrated by ʿAlī ibn Ḥātim, from al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī, from his father, from Faḍālah, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Sinān, from Abū ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:
Whoever does not attend the congregation of the people in the two ʿIds, then let him perform ghusl, apply whatever perfume he finds, and pray by himself just as he prays in congregation.

key_terms.الْعِيدَيْنِ: the two ʿId festivals, ʿId al-Fiṭr and ʿId al-Aḍḥā
key_terms.جَمَاعَةَ: the congregation or collective gathering for prayer
key_terms.فَلْيَغْتَسِلْ: let him perform ghusl as ritual washing
key_terms.وَلْيَتَطَيَّبْ: let him apply fragrance or perfume

ai.seo_question: What should someone do if they miss the congregational ʿId prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith states that if a person does not attend the congregational salat of the two ʿIds, he should still prepare himself with ghusl and fragrance and perform the prayer individually. It reflects a jurisprudential ruling concerning the observance of ʿId prayer outside the presence of the congregational setting.
